name: mlx-spy
description: Monitoring and control for LLM inference servers on Apple Silicon

scripts.build: mkdir -p bin && bun build src/main.ts --compile --outfile bin/mlx-spy && rm -f .*.bun-build
scripts.install-bin: bun run build && mkdir -p "${PREFIX:-$HOME/.local}/bin" && install -m 0755 bin/mlx-spy "${PREFIX:-$HOME/.local}/bin/mlx-spy"
